objective:
Take this network's entry on paradigm.xyz/puzzles/amm from about 528.2 to #1 (528.4152; places 1-7 sit at 528.10-528.42). Base: lb-4 (seat #39), Taylor (gtmcknight)'s solved policy (github.com/gtmcknight/amm-sim at 4812a6382311624e1506aca131ca35c378f930d9, research/solved) with a two-component filter and an exact-arithmetic arb/retail tell; +3.20 over qt1 on about 1,850 fresh engine seeds, peak 225k, 22,946 runtime bytes, source sha256 a243bb3570545fb614d8995ced61e811db8e075af68e636add20eaf8fbaeebfb, bundle in https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/93cc15561f172c49c8bce174143333ede904fdbfcf51276cbbeb514d4f5b614e. Credit Taylor in every file.
Measured levers on Taylor's replica, over lb-4's policy:
(1) rival tracking: rc-joint's rival64 (64 particles, rival estimate and synced flag only) is +0.145 se 0.015 (https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/19bf5534225de5b3d201baaf0e35f9f2a8671120380295ea7726bf6379caedc1); needs a gas-cheap form.
(2) table compression costs 0.111: full kappa 1e-5 tables beat the compressed lookup by that much (https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/4a41a90c67cf9add7e0c4f382e60c411bbf8ed340874aead14be76f4d09951f7); recover it in the size budget.
(3) refit tables: about +0.05 on the engine, already ported (rp-3, https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/31c415ffbbcdc36d91a30d4f4a8817406d3ab96b34df29d08ac28ad3e41432ba).
(4) research: the true price is worth +1.19 more, nearly all between arb pins; the tell flag itself adds only 0.006 (https://api.imd.fun/artifacts/3dc2d521ec738b3659160a4b5ce04b04022a7ba85d9937fbfaafb544cc9d7a2f).
Kit: use https://raw.githubusercontent.com/identity-md-launches/goal-3178-build-shared-evaluation-kit/45e7563d1a29ffca9d608fdf60c90bf2624d2d01/ (setup_fast.sh, ammfast/, baselines/, score.py, engine_eval.py; README first). Stop a candidate early with score.py when it is clearly worse.
Limits for any contract: Paradigm takes at most 50,000 source characters (lb-4 is 49,905); deployed <= 24,576 bytes; engine afterSwap peak <= 245,000 with 0 OOG.
Gates for a contract, in order: P (Taylor's gates.py reproduces), Q (replica: choose on 64000..65023, report on 10000..12047, paired vs lb-4's policy and qt1), T (Solidity tell labels equal the Python reference on 50 replica seeds), F (fees within 0.01 bps on 50 x 2,000 callbacks), G (size, characters, peak), E (fresh engine seeds from 10,000,000 up, never reused, paired vs lb-4 and qt1, each alone vs the 30 bps VanillaStrategy). No command over 8 minutes; state under scratch/. The requester asks the user before any submission.
